paragraphs.source_en: “Mr. Suzuki, just think of it: I went to all that trouble, most earnestly, to ask him about Mr. Kangetsu, and the whole thing was made an utter mess. I was simply furious. Still, obligation is obligation. When one goes to someone’s house to make inquiries, one cannot very well pretend indifference and leave it at that, so afterward I had the rickshaw man take him a dozen bottles of beer. And what do you suppose happened? He actually said, ‘I have no reason to accept such a thing. Take it back!’ The rickshaw man said, ‘No, this is a token of thanks. Please accept it.’ Then listen to the nasty thing he said: ‘I lick jam every day, but I have never drunk anything bitter like beer.’ And with that he turned on his heel and went inside. He does not even know how to say one civil word. Now tell me, is that not outrageous?” said Mrs. Nose.
